item.title: Tonawanda Seneca Nation presses GCEDC for answers on STREAM data center proposal
item.description: The Tonawanda Seneca Nation sent the Genesee County Economic Development Center a dozen detailed questions earlier this month about the proposed STREAM data center at WNY STAMP, including information on environmental reviews, water usage, and the project's impact on the Nation's treaty-confirmed reservation territory.

item.title: Most attendees at Stream Data Center information session remain opposed to project
item.description: Photo by Howard Owens Stream Data Centers hosted an information session at the Alabama Fire Hall on Monday evening, as opposition to the proposed 2.2 million square foot data center at STAMP remained strong among many who attended.If the goal of Stream was to win over hearts and minds, that appeared not to be the case for seven of the people The Batavian interviewed at the workshop, as well as several people The Batavian spoke to during the course of the event.
